name: czrecoil_frame_update_hw_api_menu_item
description: CZRecoilFrame::UpdateHwApiMenuItem updates or removes a hardware API menu command UI item.
known_limits: No VC COFF byte target covers 0x4317d0 yet; the helper currently has functional evidence only.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly/decompilation at 0x4317d0 validates the RemoveMenu path when apiIndex exceeds m_acceptedD3DDeviceCount, SetCheck from m_hwApiCmdUiState[apiIndex], and SetText with "Accelerator - %s (%s)" from zVid::GetHwApiDescription/GetHwApiDriverName.
The native smoke verifies a checked hardware API text update through OnUpdateHwApi2CmdUI and removal of an unavailable hardware API command through OnUpdateHwApi3CmdUI.
